verdict.rationale: Highnote provides real-time authorization controls (spend rules, velocity controls, collaborative authorization for approve/decline logic) and a dedicated Disputes Team for chargeback handling, which cover part of the fraud-fighting story. However there is no evidence of network fraud scores or Highnote's own fraud-detection models surfaced at auth time, no dedicated suspicious-activity alerting, and no explicit tooling described for blocking/freezing and reissuing a compromised card. Missing for 10: fraud score/model surfacing at authorization, suspicious-activity alert system, and explicit block-and-reissue card workflow.
